moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty … believed to have sprained his ankle … not considered a long‑term injury
moments.why: A high‑profile NFL rookie injury but with relief it’s only a sprain—big drama for fantasy owners and Raiders fans alike.

moments.author: Ian Rapoport
moments.quote: Jeanty sprained his ankle … Raiders breathing a sigh of relief
moments.why: It amplifies the sentiment—team‑wide relief captured in a viral quote, sparking tons of reaction.

moments.author: Pat McAfee
moments.quote: “It is best case scenario” on Jeanty’s ankle sprain
moments.why: Sharp, optimistic take from another big media figure—quick to catch fire among fans.
